question: What was the rank of India in AIBA World Youth Boxing Championship 2021 held in Poland?
solution:
The correct answer is** __1__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India secured **first rank** with **8 gold and 3 bronze medals**.
 
• The **2021 **AIBA World Youth Boxing Championship (21st) were held in Kielce, Poland, from 13 to 23 April 2021.
 
• Its the third time in tournament's history when men and women fought the same championship.
 
• **Russia** was first runner up in the tournament followed by** Uzbekistan.**
 
• Russia won** three golds, five silvers and three bronze medals** in the championship whereas Uzbekistan won** three golds, one silver and six bronze medals.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Nikhat Zareen** became only the fifth Indian female boxer to become a world champion in **2022 Women's World Boxing Championships in Instanbul.**
 
• **Manisha (57kg)** and** Parveen (63kg)** signed off with** bronze medals **after their semi-finals finish at the 2022 World Boxing Championship.
 
• India and Turkey were both at the runner up in 2022 World Boxing Championship with a gold and two bronze medals.
 
• **Chinese Taipei** secured third place in the championship.
